symptom: TX slave sdw:3:0:0217:0110:00:3 status=UNATTACHED at codec probe time
mechanism: initialization_complete is signaled by sdw_handle_slave_status() in bus.c:2038 only when slave reaches SDW_SLAVE_ATTACHED. TX slave never reaches ATTACHED so completion never fires.
